description: This file defines the CatalogItemService class which implements ICatalogItemService. It manages CRUD operations and listing of catalog items by interacting with HTTP endpoints and lookup services for brands and types.

classes.name: CatalogItemService
classes.description: Provides operations for managing catalog items, including create, edit, delete, get by ID, and listing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item via HTTP POST.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item via HTTP PUT.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID via HTTP DELETE.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by ID, including associated brand and type names.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, including brand and type names, with logging.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves an unpaged list of catalog items, including associated brand and type names, with logging.
